summary: Firelookout.ca places a Gleam lookout at Peace River, BC, and says it is unknown whether it still stands; no other source found.

facts.status_note: Firelookout.ca says it is unknown whether the lookout is still standing.

evidence.supports: Location given as Peace River, BC, Canada

evidence.quote: Unknown if this lookout is still standing.

notes_for_editor: Only one source: the Firelookout.ca register entry, which gives a location, coordinates and an unknown-status line. It has no tower type, height, year built or history. Two web searches and a second register fetch found nothing else about a Gleam lookout. The story is short because there is almost nothing citable; an editor may prefer to hold publication until a second source turns up. The brief's kind and access remain unknown. The brief's local unit, Peace River Regional District, is left out of the story because the cited page does not name it.
